message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: construction without permit, no safety supervision, unqualified personnel, high formwork collapse causing death. This is a case of dangerous construction leading to death. Likely charge: "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident) or "以危险方法危害公共安全罪"? In examples, similar to "危险物品肇事" for explosion, "重大责任事故" for construction accidents. Also "危害公共安全罪" includes dangerous construction? Chinese law: Article 133 of Criminal Law: "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" includes causing death by dangerous construction, etc. Also there is "重大责任事故罪" under Article 138 (dangerous work). In examples: For construction collapse causing death, they used "重大责任事故". Example: Wu case with explosion, they used "重大责任事故". Also earlier example: "危害公共安全" used for high support collapse? Let's see examples: The case with Wu (explosion) used "重大责任事故". The case with Xu (construction safety) also "重大责任事故". So likely "重大责任事故". Also maybe "非法施工" not a crime. So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
